The '''Fakir sector fleet''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|formation]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], two [[Thran-class vessel|''Thran''-class vessels]] were deployed to the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="Missing" />
